business_problem: Bpifrance needed to modernize legacy batch core-banking and information systems so chatbot answers, risk calculations, audits, and cross-business research could happen in real time.
solution_summary: Bpifrance expanded its use of MongoDB Atlas from four applications into a broader cloud data platform that now supports 35 applications across several clusters for 250 users. The bank uses Atlas to add context back into chatbot interactions by digitally slicing business-line information into MongoDB and comparing it with user questions, while Confluent streams core-banking changes so outstanding balances and risk can be calculated in real time instead of D+1 or batch windows. For analytics and reporting, Atlas Data Federation lets teams combine, enrich, and transform data across multiple sources to build their own risk-analysis datasets. This architecture improves answer quality, auditability, and self-service access to trusted financial data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores contextual business-line and core-banking data for chatbot, audit, and research workloads.

solution_components.name: Confluent
solution_components.role: Streams core-banking changes so real-time deltas reach MongoDB-driven services.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Data Federation
solution_components.role: Combines and transforms data across clusters and sources for reporting and risk analysis.

data_flow: Business-line data is sliced into MongoDB Atlas, where chatbot context and core-banking events are matched in real time; Confluent streams changes, and Atlas Data Federation combines cluster data for risk reports and 360-degree research.
business_outcome: Bpifrance improved chatbot relevance, moved core banking and risk calculations into real time, and made audits and 360-degree research easier for teams.
metrics: Bpifrance's MongoDB platform had 4 applications before 2021.
Two years ago, the public entity opted for MongoDB Atlas, which contains 35 applications spread over several clusters for 250 users.
architecture_clues: Legacy batch and D+1 processing was replaced with real-time streaming for core banking.
Atlas Data Federation is used to combine and transform data across multiple sources.
MongoDB Atlas stores the contextual slices used to ground chatbot responses.
evidence_quotes: By combining several technologies within the project known as MPA, information from Bpifrance will be digitally "sliced" into a MongoDB Atlas database, then compared with information from a chatbot user.
Thanks to the combination of Confluent and MongoDB, we have moved to real-time Core Banking.
Through Data Federation, Atlas users will be able to combine, enrich, and transform data, run federated queries across multiple data sources, and generate data to their preferred destination.
